PROGRESS_STATUS, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(A.MM_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS MM_DATE, NVL(A.EE_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS EE_DATE, A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.MM_STATUS,'N'),'N','5','ED','2')) AS MM_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'RC','2','ED','2','5')) AS DD_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'ED','2','5')) AS DD_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'RC','2','ED','2','5')) AS EE_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'ED','2','5')) AS EE_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK1_STATUS,'N'),'N','5','B','6','Y','2','5')) AS ES_MK1_STATUS,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD1_STATUS,'N'),'N','5','B','6','Y','2','5')) AS ES_PD1_STATUS,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA1_STATUS,'N'),'N','5','B','6','Y','2','5')) AS ES_QA1_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3', 'FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_FI_STATUS,'N'),'N','5','B','6','Y','2','5')) AS ES_FI_STATUS ,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3','FY','4', 'GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK_STATUS,'N'),'N','5','B','6','Y','2','5')) AS ES_MK_STATUS,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','3','FY','4','GB','6', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD_STATUS,'N'),'N','5','B','6','Y','2','5')) AS ES_PD_STATUS,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.MM_STATUS,'N'),'N','/resources/images/icon_w.gif','ED','/resources/images/icon_r.gif')) AS MM_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'RC','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','ED','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS DD_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'ED','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS DD_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'RC','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','ED','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS EE_RECV_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'ED','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS EE_ED_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK1_STATUS,'N'),'N','/resources/images/icon_w.gif','B','/resources/images/icon_b.gif','Y','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS ES_MK1_STATUS,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD1_STATUS,'N'),'N','/resources/images/icon_w.gif','B','/resources/images/icon_b.gif','Y','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS ES_PD1_STATUS,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA1_STATUS,'N'),'N','/resources/images/icon_w.gif','B','/resources/images/icon_b.gif','Y','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS ES_QA1_STATUS, DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif', 'FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_FI_STATUS,'N'),'N','/resources/images/icon_w.gif','B','/resources/images/icon_b.gif','Y','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS ES_FI_STATUS ,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif','FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif', 'GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK_STATUS,'N'),'N','/resources/images/icon_w.gif','B','/resources/images/icon_b.gif','Y','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS ES_MK_STATUS,
DECODE(A.RECV_FLAG,'ED','/resources/images/icon_y.gif','FY','/resources/images/icon_g.gif','GB','/resources/images/icon_b.gif', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD_STATUS,'N'),'N','/resources/images/icon_w.gif','B','/resources/images/icon_b.gif','Y','/resources/images/icon_r.gif','/resources/images/icon_w.gif')) AS ES_PD_STATUS,
NVL(A.RD_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS RD_DATE, NVL(A.DD_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS DD_DATE, NVL(A.ES_DATE,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD')) AS ES_DATE,
A.PLANT AS PLANT, A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AS BYCA_COMORG_CODE, A.BUYER AS BUYER, A.OPKG_SEQ AS OPKG_SEQ, A.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ, A.RECV_FLAG AS RECV_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG AS USE_FLAG, A.GUBUN_FLAG AS GUBUN_FLAG, DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK1_STATUS,'N'),'Y', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD1_STATUS,'N'),'Y', DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA1_STATUS,'N'),'Y','ED','RC'),'RC'),'RC') AS ES_STATUS, NVL(A.SAFETY_OPEN_FLAG,'N') AS SAFETY_OPEN_FLAG,
DECODE(NVL(A.MM_STATUS,'N'),'N','미완료','ED','완료') AS MM_STATUS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.MM_WORK_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||' '|| DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.MM_WORK_DATE),''),'','', SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.MM_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.MM_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),3,2)) AS MM_WORK_DATE, replace(A.MM_REMARK, chr(13)||CHR(10), ' ') AS MM_REMARK, DECODE(NVL(A.DD_STATUS,'N'),'N','미처리','RC','접수','ED','완료') AS DD_STATUS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.DD_WORK_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||' '|| DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.DD_WORK_DATE),''),'','', SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.DD_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.DD_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),3,2)) AS DD_WORK_DATE, replace(A.DD_REMARK, chr(13)||CHR(10), ' ') AS DD_REMARK, DECODE(NVL(A.EE_STATUS,'N'),'N','미처리','RC','접수','ED','완료') AS EE_STATUS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.EE_WORK_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||' '|| DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.EE_WORK_DATE),''),'','', SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.EE_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.EE_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),3,2)) AS EE_WORK_DATE, replace(A.EE_REMARK, chr(13)||CHR(10), ' ') AS EE_REMARK, DECODE(NVL(A.ES_MK_STATUS,A.ES_MK1_STATUS),'N','미확인','Y','확인','B','반려') AS ES_MK_STATUS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.ES_MK_WORK_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||' '|| DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.ES_MK_WORK_DATE),''),'','', SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_MK_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_MK_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),3,2)) AS ES_MK_WORK_DATE, replace(A.ES_MK1_REMARK, chr(13)||CHR(10), ' ') AS ES_MK1_REMARK, DECODE(NVL(A.ES_PD_STATUS,A.ES_PD1_STATUS),'N','미확인','Y','확인','B','반려') AS ES_PD1_STATUS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.ES_PD_WORK_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||' '|| DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.ES_PD_WORK_DATE),''),'','', SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_PD_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_PD_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),3,2)) AS ES_PD_WORK_DATE, replace(A.ES_PD1_REMARK, chr(13)||CHR(10), ' ') AS ES_PD1_REMARK, DECODE(NVL(A.ES_QA_STATUS,A.ES_QA1_STATUS),'N','미확인','Y','확인','B','반려') AS ES_QA1_STATUS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.ES_QA_WORK_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||' '|| DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.ES_QA_WORK_DATE),''),'','', SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_QA_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_QA_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),3,2)) AS ES_QA_WORK_DATE, replace(A.ES_QA1_REMARK, chr(13)||CHR(10), ' ') AS ES_QA1_REMARK, DECODE(A.ES_FI_STATUS,'N','미확인','Y','확인','B','반려') AS ES_FI_STATUS_YN, TO_CHAR(A.ES_FI_WORK_DATE,'YYYYMMDD')||' '|| DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.ES_FI_WORK_DATE),''),'','', SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_FI_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),1,2)||':'||SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(A.ES_FI_WORK_DATE,'HH24MISS'),3,2)) AS ES_FI_WORK_DATE, replace(A.ES_FI_REMARK, chr(13)||CHR(10), ' ') AS ES_FI_REMARK, DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.AGENT),''),'','', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT)) AS AGENT_SELECT, DECODE(NVL(TRIM(A.BUYER),''),'','', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.BUYER)) AS BUYER_REQ, A.CHANGE_DATE AS CHANGE_DATE, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = A.CHANGE_USER_ID) AS CHANGE_USER, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DONGOPKG_HISTORY WHERE PLANT = A.PLANT AND BYCA_COMORG_CODE = A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND OPKG_SEQ = A.OPKG_SEQ AND RD_DATE = A.RD_DATE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS RETURN_CNT, (SELECT '( 마케팅팀 : '|| NVL(sum(decode(RETURN_USER_DEPT,'MK',1,0)),0) || ','|| ' 상품개발팀 : '|| NVL(sum(decode(RETURN_USER_DEPT,'PD',1,0)),0) || ','|| ' 품질보증팀 : '|| NVL(sum(decode(RETURN_USER_DEPT,'QA',1,0)),0) || ','|| ' 최종확인 : '|| NVL(sum(decode(RETURN_USER_DEPT,'FI',1,0)),0) || ' )' FROM DONGOPKG_HISTORY WHERE PLANT = A.PLANT AND BYCA_COMORG_CODE = A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE AND BUYER = A.BUYER AND OPKG_SEQ = A.OPKG_SEQ AND RD_DATE = A.RD_DATE AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO)AS RETURN_TEAM_CNT
FROM DONGOPKG A WHERE A.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BYCA_COMORG_CODE IN ('KRDONG0732')
AND A.RD_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --시작일
AND A.MM_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --디자인완료일
AND A.EE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --1차컨펌완료일
AND A.ES_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} --최종확인일
AND A.RECV_FLAG = #{st_recv_flag}
AND A.EE_STATUS = #{st_ee_status}
AND A.MM_STATUS = #{st_mm_status}
AND NVL(A.ES_FI_STATUS,'N') = #{st_fi_status}
AND (A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || #{st_desc_spec} || '%' OR A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{st_desc_spec}) || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{st_desc_spec}) || '%' OR A.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{st_desc_spec}) || '%' OR A.SPECIFICATION LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{st_desc_spec}) || '%' )
AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO LIKE '%' || #{st_buyer_item_no} || '%'
AND A.ITEM_NO = #{st_item_code}
AND A.PRODUCT_FLAG = #{st_product_flag}
ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.RD_DATE DESC --시작일
ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.MM_DATE DESC --디자인완료일
ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.EE_DATE DESC --1차컴펌완료일
ORDER BY SO_FLAG, A.USE_FLAG DESC, A.ES_DATE DESC --최종확정일
) X ) Y
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
